# Cv (web)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Loads the published CV page through GraphQL on the Next server and hands it to the page sanitized ([public-site flow](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md)).

## Techniques

`server-only` loader wrapped in React `cache`, so metadata and page share one request per render; richtext is sanitized with DOMPurify before it leaves the server (D13). `CvPage` asks `cvPageList` (`isMain = true`, newest, one entry), `cvContact` and `cvPageText`; a failed list or text throws to `error.tsx`. The signed-in refetch uses the data-only `CvPageVisitor` (same selections, picked from `CV_PAGE_ROOT_FIELDS`, no text). `mainResumeOf` reads `cvPageList.data[0]` (Q-G7).

## Technologies

Next.js App Router, the web GraphQL server client, DOMPurify.

## Entry points

Facade `index.ts`: `mainResumeOf`; `app/cv/page.tsx` and the BFF route import `loadCvPage` and `answerCvRead` from `CvPage.server.ts` (reads the session through `features/session` server files); the root field selections and types in `Cv.graphql.ts`, declared as a query in `CvPage.server.ts`.

## Where to change what

A new CV field: the query and types in `Cv.graphql.ts` (and the committed SDL in cms-api); render it in `views/cv`.
